name: m4-devirt-sym-prof
description: Prototype evidence for devirtualising `Symbol.isClass` / `isPackageClass` / `isRefinementClass` / `info` / `rawInfo` (made final; see `DEVIRT-SYMBOL-PREDICATES.md` in the `devirt-symbol-predicates-625c33` worktree). PMU profile through the kperf helper (cycles, instructions) of the scala corpus on the M4, one fork per build, to attribute `vtable stub` / `itable stub` samples to their caller frames with `--lines` in each build. Not a timing A/B.
Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap, single-shot 4+4 ops, as `m4-int00e3bb-kperf-l1d`.

variantDescriptions.proto: base + uncommitted prototype: final kind predicates (klass checks + raw PACKAGE bit) and final `info`/`rawInfo`
